config.label: Contact address sent in the User-Agent to the national registry, as Brønnøysundregistrene asks of API clients
config.description: Contact address sent in the User-Agent to the national registry, as Brønnøysundregistrene asks of API clients. Unset means an anonymous client, which may be blocked upstream.

config.label: Companies House REST API key, required for the United Kingdom (GB)
config.description: Companies House REST API key, required for the United Kingdom (GB). Free from developer.company-information.service.gov.uk. Unset means GB lookups return an upstream_error naming this variable; every other country still answers.

config.label: Bolagsverket OAuth 2 client id, required for Sweden (SE) together with BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_SECRET
config.description: Bolagsverket OAuth 2 client id, required for Sweden (SE) together with BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_SECRET. Free, no contract: request both from Bolagsverket's kundanmälan form. Unset means SE lookups return an upstream_error naming both variables; every other country still answers.

config.label: Bolagsverket OAuth 2 client secret, the other half of BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_ID
config.description: Bolagsverket OAuth 2 client secret, the other half of BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_ID. Both are needed before Sweden (SE) can answer.

config.label: Which Bolagsverket environment the Swedish credentials belong to: 'production' (default) or 'test'
config.description: Which Bolagsverket environment the Swedish credentials belong to: 'production' (default) or 'test'. It selects the data host and the token host as a pair, so the two can never be mixed.
